rationale: Independent reading: held EO 11209 (30 FR 3929) establishes the Federal Development Committee for Appalachia and related arrangements; no own term (its TERM records are functions, not deadlines). Held EO 11386 (33 FR 5) sec. 9(b): 'The Federal Development Committee for Appalachia, established by Executive Order No. 11209 of March 25, 1965, is hereby abolished and that order is hereby revoked.' Whole-order revocation, no savings clause. My own status: NO; agree. D6: no held amendment between 1965 and 1967; EO 11608 (partial revocation of EO 11386 re Alaska) and EO 12553 (revoking EO 11386) do not revive EO 11209 (no revival words); held-text hits for 11209 are only 11209, 11386 and unrelated numbers. Minor defect: rationale says the ACT machinery found no pair, but APP-sourced ACT:EO:11209>EO:11386 records exist; the decision correctly relies on the FR actor text. Accept.
